_about: Per-case budgets of tests/canvas/gpu-pixels.js by host, from a calibration run of the real GPU output (CALIBRATE=1 scripts/gpu-pixels.sh, CALIBRATE=1 native/tests/macos-harness/gpu-pixels.sh): interiorPx, solidPx and the per-object-class interior counts (c_hole, c_sel, c_top, c_bottom, c_inner, c_silk, c_conn, c_other) 1.2 x measured + 6, edgeMean 1.1 x measured + 0.15. Every fault of FAULTS=all must exceed them.
_rasterAbout: Fixed DPR 1 signed RGB residual fingerprints in 64 px tiles. Dense fit single and netColors use these in addition to the absolute component budgets. CAPTURE_RASTER prints observations for explicit review. CALIBRATE does not change fingerprints.
